meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 容器装上固定的 Firecrawl AnyDoc 命令行工具和配套技能后,Claude 能把本地附带的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等文件直接转成 Markdown 再读,不用上传到外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附带在本地的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等文档,又不想把它们上传到托管解析器时触发。

say.text: 把附件那份 Word 文档转成 Markdown,再总结相关段落。
这份 PPTX 转成 Markdown 后给我列个大纲。
say.note: 转换在容器内本地完成。

say.text: 这份扫描版 PDF 能转吗?
say.note: 只有图像的 PDF 会明确报错,且不上传。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can convert attached Word, Excel, PowerPoint and other office files to Markdown inside the NanoClaw container, without sending them to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent needs to read attached Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or similar local documents without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attached Word file to Markdown, then summarize the key sections.
Turn this PPTX into Markdown and list an outline.
say_en.note: Conversion stays local in the container.

say_en.text: Can this scanned PDF be converted?
say_en.note: Image-only PDFs fail clearly and are not uploaded.
